rationale: X is at least at parity with the references: it accurately traces subscription setup, deferred confirmation, broadcast encoding and instrumentation, adapter delivery, default retransmission, and worker-pool dispatch for user callbacks. Its distinctions among `coder: nil`, JSON decoding, and custom broadcast encoding agree with the implementations in `actioncable/lib/action_cable/channel/streams.rb` and `actioncable/lib/action_cable/server/broadcasting.rb`. It also covers every requested edge case, including stopped and rejected subscriptions, name coercion, and the differing propagation of encode, default-decode, and worker-handled callback failures. A focused judge run of `actioncable/bin/test test/channel/stream_test.rb test/server/broadcasting_test.rb test/channel/rejection_test.rb` completed with 21 runs, 50 assertions, and no failures or errors.
